title: Latest Note 9 update
symptom: After the latest Note 9 security update, xDrip starts missing readings and eventually never recovers, making it useless. Users report having to fallback to the Dexcom official app or use Nightwatch with Dexcom Share.
evidence_quote: The latest note 9 security update has made Xdrip useless. I've had it running for weeks and love it but after the latest update Xdrip starts missing readings and eventually just never recovers
